column1: # LANE A'S CAPTURE QUEUE FOR READ PAGES: one line per page whose address the
# read boundary now admits (or must learn) and of which no tracked skeleton
# from a live capture exists, so no reader may be built yet.
# Written by lane A (la-admissions-lead), 2026-10-10. Method and every
# argument: _audit/2026-09-28-lane-a-admissions.md. Lane K builds the main
# capture queue in parallel with the same columns; the orchestrator merges
# the two. Nothing here is loaded by this lane, and nothing here is a
# permission: the live lane takes a line only on the orchestrator's order,
# EVERY VARIABLE SEGMENT IS A PLACEHOLDER (<digits>, <slug>, <text>); the
# value comes from the tool's arguments or the operator, never from a page.
# surface-id  a short key, unique in this file
# address     the address to load, exactly as the boundary admits it
# presses     none, or the presses the line needs and the ruling that
#             permits each (a press not permitted is NOT taken)
# save        what the capture must record. Raw captures stay in the main
#             checkout's gitignored _state/; only a skeleton is ever committed
# loads       page loads, counting any control loads
# searches    searches the line types (D1-SEARCH-AS-READS caps a session at 5)
# rows        the census rows the capture serves
